name: Spaghetti Pomodoro
steps: Simmer garlic, oil and tomatoes 12 min.
Toss with pasta, basil and parmesan.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Add tomatoes, return chicken, braise 35 min.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Add warm broth a ladle at a time, 25 min.

name: Spinach Baked Ziti
steps: Mix with sauce, ricotta and spinach.
Top with mozzarella, bake 30 min at 375F.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Linguine
steps: Saute garlic and shrimp in butter 4 min.
Toss with pasta, lemon and parsley.

name: Big-Batch Minestrone
steps: Add broth, tomatoes, beans, simmer 20 min.
Add zucchini and pasta, 10 min more.

name: Smashed Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm beans with cumin and smash.
Fill with beans, avocado, onion, cilantro, lime.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Roll in tortillas with onion and cheese.

name: Slow-Cooker Carnitas Bowls
steps: Slow cook with orange, onion, garlic 4 h.

name: Sheet-Pan Shrimp Fajitas
steps: Toss peppers and onion with oil and spice, roast 8 min.
Serve in warm tortillas with lime.

name: Turkey Taco Rice Skillet
steps: Add rice, salsa, beans and 1.5 cups water; simmer 18 min.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Add tomatoes and chickpeas, simmer 20 min.

name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spice.
Simmer tomatoes with butter and spices, add cream and chicken.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Fry aromatics, add puree and spices.
Add paneer and cream, simmer 5 min.

name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Tikka
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, spice and lemon.
Roast with peppers and onion at 450F for 25 min.

name: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Cook vegetables with spices and yogurt.
Layer with par-cooked rice, steam 20 min.

name: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
steps: Fry curry paste in coconut cream.
Add chicken and coconut milk, simmer 12 min.
Add bamboo, fish sauce, basil. Serve with rice.

name: Tofu Pad Thai
steps: Toss noodles with tamarind and fish sauce.
Top with sprouts, peanuts, green onion.

name: Coconut Sweet Potato Curry
steps: Simmer sweet potato and chickpeas 15 min.

name: Pork Larb Lettuce Wraps
steps: Dress with lime, fish sauce, onion, mint, rice powder.

name: Tom Kha Gai
steps: Add sliced chicken and mushrooms, 10 min.
Season with fish sauce and lime.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Rice Bowls
steps: Sear chicken, glaze with soy, mirin, sugar, ginger.

name: Miso-Glazed Salmon
steps: Serve with rice and sauteed bok choy.

name: Vegetable Yakisoba
steps: Add noodles and sauce, toss 3 min.

name: Pork Katsu Curry
steps: Simmer onion, potato, carrot 15 min; melt in roux.

name: Gyudon (Beef & Onion Bowl)
steps: Simmer onion in dashi, soy, mirin.

name: Crispy Tofu & Edamame Bowl
steps: Toss with soy and vinegar, top with edamame and sesame.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
steps: Toss everything but feta with lemon and oil.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Saute onion and pepper with spices.
Top with feta; serve with pita.

name: Baked Falafel Bowls
steps: Pulse chickpeas, herbs, onion, garlic, spice, flour.

name: Lemon-Dill Salmon & Asparagus
steps: Roast salmon and asparagus with lemon, dill, oil 12-15 min at 425F.

name: Lemony Lentil Soup
steps: Add lentils, tomatoes, broth, cumin; simmer 30 min.

name: Lamb Kofta with Tzatziki
steps: Mix lamb with grated onion, parsley, cumin; shape on skewers.

name: Stovetop Mac & Cheese
steps: Make roux, whisk in milk, melt cheese.

name: Turkey & Bean Chili
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper.

name: Meatloaf & Mashed Potatoes
steps: Mix beef, crumbs, egg, onion, half the milk; shape loaf.
Glaze with ketchup, bake 60 min at 350F.
Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk.

name: BBQ Chicken & Sweet Potato Sheet Pan
steps: Roast drumsticks and sweet potato 20 min at 425F.
Brush with BBQ sauce, add broccoli, roast 15 min.

name: Sunday Pot Roast
steps: Add broth, paste, thyme; braise covered 2 h at 325F.

name: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
steps: Simmer onion, tomatoes, broth 10 min; blend.

name: 10-Minute Egg Fried Rice
steps: Fry rice and vegetables on high heat.
Add eggs, soy, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Beef & Broccoli
steps: Stir-fry broccoli, add sauce and beef.

name: Mapo Tofu
steps: Fry pork with doubanjiang and garlic.
Simmer tofu in sauce 8 min; finish with peppercorn and green onion.

name: Vegetable Lo Mein
steps: Toss with noodles, soy and sesame oil.

name: Steamed Ginger-Scallion Cod
steps: Top with scallions, pour over hot oil and soy.

name: Spinach & Tomato Scramble
steps: Add beaten eggs, scramble softly, top with cheese.

name: Freezer Breakfast Burritos
steps: Fill tortillas, roll, wrap and freeze.

name: Tamagoyaki & Rice
steps: Whisk eggs with mirin and soy.
Cook in thin layers, rolling each.

name: Chilaquiles Verdes
steps: Top with fried eggs, cheese, avocado.

name: Masala Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with chopped veg and turmeric.

name: Ginger Chicken Congee
steps: Simmer rice in broth with ginger 60 min, stirring.
Top with green onion, soy, sesame oil.

name: Banana Pancakes
steps: Whisk batter, fold in mashed banana.

name: Turmeric Tofu Scramble
steps: Crumble tofu into hot oil with pepper.

name: Avocado Feta Toast
steps: Smash avocado on top, add feta and tomatoes.

name: Zucchini Parmesan Frittata
steps: Pour in egg mixture, cook 5 min.

name: Caprese Ciabatta Sandwich
steps: Layer mozzarella, tomato, basil on ciabatta.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps: Assemble with beans, corn, salsa, avocado, lime.

name: Tandoori Chicken Naan Wrap
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spice.
Wrap in warm naan with cucumber and onion.

name: Cold Peanut Noodle Salad
steps: Toss with shredded veg and herbs.

name: Edamame Soba Salad
steps: Cook soba and edamame together, rinse cold.

name: Greek Chickpea Salad
steps: Toss with chickpeas, olives, feta, oil and lemon.

name: Tuna Melt
steps: Top bread with tuna and cheese, griddle until melty.

name: Quick Wonton Soup
steps: Cook wontons 6 min, add bok choy 2 min.
Season and top with green onion.

name: Turkey Avocado Wrap
steps: Layer turkey, avocado, lettuce, tomato; roll.

name: Garlic Spinach & Egg Rice Bowl
steps: Fry eggs; pile on rice, season with soy and sesame oil.

name: Black Bean Quesadillas
steps: Fill tortillas with beans, pepper, cheese.
Griddle until crisp; serve with salsa.
